correctness.rationale: On the chart where n-k nonzero coordinates are inverted, the actual equation is U^{-1}Psi=e_{k-1}(x)+c e_k(x). Writing P=product_{i<k}x_i and S=e_{k-2}(x_1,...,x_{k-1}), substitution x_k=y/(1-cy) gives exactly (1-cy)(P+x_k(S+cP))=P+yS. This is invertible near the point and proves the all-order model, including singular points k=3..n-1. The gradient vanishes precisely for at least 3 zero coordinates; irreducibility plus codimension-2 singular support yields normality via Serre. Independent tests confirmed 105 rational exact local identities, and the Hilbert-series follows from homogeneous hypersurface equation rather than the finite checks.
